summary: Full e2e retest of multi-turma refactor. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass (admin teacher create with only email/password/nome, duplicate 400, turmas CRUD + cascade delete + auto-seeded ponderacoes, scoped alunos/instrumentos/notas/ponderacoes with turma_id, missing param→422, unknown/other-teacher turma_id→404, ponderacoes sum!=100→400, admin→teacher endpoints 403). Frontend: admin form correctly shows only 3 fields (nome/email/password); teacher first-login empty state renders; TurmaFormModal creates first turma and header updates; picker-new-turma creates second turma; switching via pick-turma-{id} works; adding aluno in turma A does NOT appear in turma B (data isolation confirmed); instrumento create form has testids inst-nome/inst-tipo/inst-data/inst-save; notas/config/dashboard tabs render; export-pdf-btn downloads 'grelha_A_Matemática_08-07-2026.pdf'; picker-del-turma cascades and empty state returns.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has no response_model on POST endpoints; relies on manual _id pop + dict filtering — refactor to Pydantic response models to prevent future field leaks.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is invalid per spec — currently works only because frontend uses Bearer tokens, not cookies.
Ponderacoes sum validation uses body.CP+RRP+CM+ER != 100 but ints — no float tolerance needed; OK.
Instrumento delete does not clean up per-aluno notas (they are stored inside the instrumento doc, so cascade is implicit via delete_one — fine).
get_turma_or_404 returns 404 for cross-teacher access — semantically arguable (should be 403), but avoids leaking existence; acceptable choice.
test_credentials: admin@escola.pt / admin123 (seeded). Test teacher prof@teste.pt/prof12345 created & deleted during test; all TEST_ prefixed backend fixture teachers also deleted.
seed_data_creation: All created teachers and their cascaded turmas/alunos/instrumentos/ponderacoes cleaned up. Verified via GET /api/admin/teachers → [].
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-turma refactor fully working. Backend tests must be run with -o addopts='' because pytest-xdist parallel workers don't share module-scoped fixture state (tests share a teacher_creds fixture across tests). If more scoped resources are added, keep them self-contained OR keep pytest-xdist disabled. PDF filename format: grelha_{turma_letra}_{disciplina}_{date}.pdf.
